name: Public Works Department, Government of Chhattisgarh
summary: The state department that builds and maintains Chhattisgarh's state highways, major district roads and bridges.
about: Chhattisgarh's Public Works Department maintains state highways and district roads through some of the most heavily forested country in India. Building and keeping roads open in the southern districts has long been difficult for reasons of terrain and security alike.
facts: Responsible for Chhattisgarh's state highways and major district roads.
Also looks after most state-owned bridges and government buildings.
National highways in the state are not its responsibility — those belong to NHAI, NHIDCL or the state's national highway wing.
